title: Defender for Cloud: NGINX CVE detection and remediation on App Service
summary: Provisions a Linux container on App Service running an NGINX version affected by CVE-2026-42533, together with the map/regex configuration that makes the condition reachable. Defender for Cloud is expected to surface the finding; the remediation stage upgrades NGINX and the verify stage proves the detection clears.

safety.ingressJustification: Defender for App Service evaluates inbound request telemetry, so the scenario cannot demonstrate detection without a reachable public endpoint. The container serves only a static status dashboard and read-only JSON endpoints; it holds no data and accepts no writes.
safety.isolationNote: Deploy only to an isolated subscription you control.
safety.disclaimer: This scenario provisions an INTENTIONALLY VULNERABLE environment. Provided as-is, without warranty of any kind. USE AT YOUR OWN RISK.

cost.notes: App Service Plan B1 plus Basic ACR. Defender plan charges are subscription-scoped and are not included; enabling Defender for App Service and Containers may incur separate per-resource costs.

nginxVersion.description: NGINX version installed in the container image. Determines whether the scenario is in its affected or remediated state.

vulnerabilityStatus.description: Which scenario configuration to write at container start. 'vulnerable' emits the affected map/regex block; 'remediated' removes it.

baseOsImage.description: Base OS image for the container build.

nodeMajorVersion.description: Node.js major version serving the status API behind NGINX.

port.description: Port the Node.js application listens on behind the NGINX reverse proxy.

npmNetworkMode.description: Whether the image build may reach the npm registry. 'offline' supports air-gapped builds.

defenderEnabled.description: Whether the run activates Defender plans and performs a post-verification scan. Disabling produces a deployment without detection evidence.

assertions.label: Resource group exists and carries the ownership and expiry tags
Container image is present in the registry
Deployed image digest matches the current source fingerprint
User-assigned managed identity holds AcrPull on the registry
Running NGINX binary reports the expected version
Running NGINX configuration contains the affected map/regex block
Container self-assessment computes the vulnerable state from the running system
assertions.reference: Computed at container start from the NGINX binary version and the active configuration, never from the requested parameter.

assertions.label: Requested Defender plans report the configured tier
Defender assessment inventory returned data for the resource group
Target CVE appears in Defender findings
assertions.reference: Vulnerability assessment is asynchronous; reports unknown until the image scan completes within the latency budget.

assertions.label: Running NGINX binary reports the fixed version after remediation
Affected map/regex block is absent from the running configuration
Container self-assessment no longer computes the vulnerable state
Target CVE no longer appears in Defender findings
All scenario resources were released and the resource group is gone
